title: Google\Cloud\Channel\V1\Gapic\CloudChannelServiceGapicClient
name: CloudChannelServiceGapicClient
description: Service Description: CloudChannelService enables Google cloud resellers and distributors to manage their customers, channel partners, entitlements and reports.

methods.name: customerName
methods.description: Formats a string containing the fully-qualified path to represent a customer resource.

methods.name: entitlementName
methods.description: Formats a string containing the fully-qualified path to represent a entitlement resource.

methods.name: offerName
methods.description: Formats a string containing the fully-qualified path to represent a offer resource.

methods.name: productName
methods.description: Formats a string containing the fully-qualified path to represent a product resource.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses a formatted name string and returns an associative array of the components in the name.

params.name: formattedName
params.description: The formatted name string

params.name: template
params.description: Optional name of template to match

returns.description: An associative array from name component IDs to component values.

methods.name: getOperationsClient
methods.description: Return an OperationsClient object with the same endpoint as $this.

methods.name: resumeOperation
methods.description: Resume an existing long running operation that was previously started by a long running API method. If $methodName is not provided, or does not match a long running API method, then the operation can still be resumed, but the OperationResponse object will not deserialize the final response.

params.name: operationName
params.description: The name of the long running operation

params.name: methodName
params.description: The name of the method used to start the operation

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor.

methods.name: listCustomers
methods.description: List downstream [Customer][google.cloud.channel.v1.Customer]s.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller account from which to list customers. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns a requested [Customer][google.cloud.channel.v1.Customer] resource.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the customer to retrieve. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

methods.name: checkCloudIdentityAccountsExist
methods.description: Confirms the existence of Cloud Identity accounts, based on the domain and whether the Cloud Identity accounts are owned by the reseller.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller account. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}

params.name: domain
params.description: Required. Domain for which the Cloud Identity account customer is fetched.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new [Customer][google.cloud.channel.v1.Customer] resource under the reseller or distributor account.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of reseller account in which to create the customer. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}

params.name: customer
params.description: Required. The customer to create.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing [Customer][google.cloud.channel.v1.Customer] resource belonging to the reseller or distributor.

params.name: customer
params.description: Required. New contents of the customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes the given [Customer][google.cloud.channel.v1.Customer] permanently and irreversibly.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the customer to delete.

methods.name: provisionCloudIdentity
methods.description: Creates a Cloud Identity for the given customer using the customer's information or the information provided here, if present.

params.name: customer
params.description: Required. Resource name of the customer. Format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

methods.name: listEntitlements
methods.description: List [Entitlement][google.cloud.channel.v1.Entitlement]s belonging to a customer.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller's customer account for which to list entitlements. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

methods.name: listTransferableSkus
methods.description: List [TransferableSku][google.cloud.channel.v1.TransferableSku]s of a customer based on Cloud Identity ID or Customer Name in the request.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller's account. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}

methods.name: listTransferableOffers
methods.description: List [TransferableOffer][google.cloud.channel.v1.TransferableOffer]s of a customer based on Cloud Identity ID or Customer Name in the request.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller's account.

params.name: sku
params.description: Required. SKU for which the Offers are being looked up.

methods.name: getEntitlement
methods.description: Returns a requested [Entitlement][google.cloud.channel.v1.Entitlement] resource.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the entitlement to retrieve. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{id}

methods.name: createEntitlement
methods.description: Creates an entitlement for a customer.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of reseller's customer account in which to create the entitlement. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

params.name: entitlement
params.description: Required. The entitlement to create.

methods.name: changeParameters
methods.description: Change parameters of the entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The name of the entitlement to update. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

params.name: parameters
params.description: Required. Entitlement parameters to update. Only editable parameters are allowed to be changed.

methods.name: changeRenewalSettings
methods.description: Updates the renewal settings for an existing customer entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The name of the entitlement to update. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

params.name: renewalSettings
params.description: Required. New renewal settings.

methods.name: changeOffer
methods.description: Updates the Offer for an existing customer entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The name of the entitlement to update. Format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

params.name: offer
params.description: Required. New Offer. Format: accounts/{account_id}/offers/{offer_id}.

methods.name: startPaidService
methods.description: Starts paid service for a trial entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The name of the entitlement for which paid service is being started. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

methods.name: suspendEntitlement
methods.description: Suspends a previously fulfilled entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the entitlement to suspend. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

methods.name: cancelEntitlement
methods.description: Cancels a previously fulfilled entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the entitlement to cancel. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

methods.name: activateEntitlement
methods.description: Activates a previously suspended entitlement. The entitlement must be in a suspended state for it to be activated. Entitlements suspended for pending ToS acceptance can't be activated using this method. An entitlement activation is a long-running operation and can result in updates to the state of the customer entitlement.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the entitlement to activate. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements/{entitlement_id}

methods.name: transferEntitlements
methods.description: Transfers customer entitlements to new reseller.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of reseller's customer account where the entitlements transfer to. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

params.name: entitlements
params.description: Required. The new entitlements to be created or transferred.

methods.name: transferEntitlementsToGoogle
methods.description: Transfers customer entitlements from current reseller to Google.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of reseller's customer account where the entitlements transfer from. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}

params.name: entitlements
params.description: Required. The entitlements to be transferred to Google.

methods.name: listChannelPartnerLinks
methods.description: List [ChannelPartnerLink][google.cloud.channel.v1.ChannelPartnerLink]s belonging to a distributor.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller account for listing channel partner links. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}

methods.name: getChannelPartnerLink
methods.description: Returns a requested [ChannelPartnerLink][google.cloud.channel.v1.ChannelPartnerLink] resource.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the channel partner link to retrieve. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/channelPartnerLinks/{id} where {id} is the Cloud Identity ID of the partner.

methods.name: createChannelPartnerLink
methods.description: Initiates a channel partner link between a distributor and a reseller or between resellers in an n-tier reseller channel.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of reseller's account for which to create a channel partner link. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}

params.name: channelPartnerLink
params.description: Required. The channel partner link to create. Either channel_partner_link.reseller_cloud_identity_id or domain can be used to create a link.

methods.name: updateChannelPartnerLink
methods.description: Updates a channel partner link. A distributor calls this method to change a link's status. For example, suspend a partner link.

params.name: name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the channel partner link to cancel. The name takes the format: accounts/{account_id}/channelPartnerLinks/{id} where {id} is the Cloud Identity ID of the partner.

params.name: channelPartnerLink
params.description: Required. The channel partner link to update. Only field channel_partner_link.link_state is allowed to be updated.

params.name: updateMask
params.description: Required. The update mask that applies to the resource. The only allowable value for update mask is channel_partner_link.link_state.

methods.name: listProducts
methods.description: Lists the Products the reseller is authorized to sell.

params.name: account
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller account. Format: accounts/{account_id}.

methods.name: listSkus
methods.description: Lists the SKUs for a product the reseller is authorized to sell.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the Product for which to list SKUs. The parent takes the format: products/{product_id}. Supports products/- to retrieve SKUs for all products.

params.name: account
params.description: Required. Resource name of the reseller. Format: accounts/{account_id}.

methods.name: listOffers
methods.description: Lists the Offers the reseller can sell.

params.name: parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the reseller account from which to list Offers. The parent takes the format: accounts/{account_id}.

methods.name: listPurchasableSkus
methods.description: Lists the Purchasable SKUs for following cases:.

params.name: customer
params.description: Required. The resource name of the customer for which to list SKUs. Format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}.

methods.name: listPurchasableOffers
methods.description: Lists the Purchasable Offers for the following cases:.

params.name: customer
params.description: Required. The resource name of the customer for which to list Offers. Format: accounts/{account_id}/customers/{customer_id}.

methods.name: registerSubscriber
methods.description: Registers a service account with subscriber privileges on the Cloud Pub/Sub topic created for this Channel Services account. Once you create a subscriber, you will get the events as per [SubscriberEvent][google.cloud.channel.v1.SubscriberEvent].

params.name: account
params.description: Required. Resource name of the account.

params.name: serviceAccount
params.description: Required. Service account which will provide subscriber access to the registered topic.

methods.name: unregisterSubscriber
methods.description: Unregisters a service account with subscriber privileges on the Cloud Pub/Sub topic created for this Channel Services account. If there are no more service account left with sunbscriber privileges, the topic will be deleted. You can check this by calling ListSubscribers api.

params.name: account
params.description: Required. Resource name of the account.

params.name: serviceAccount
params.description: Required. Service account which will be unregistered from getting subscriber access to the topic.

methods.name: listSubscribers
methods.description: Lists service accounts with subscriber privileges on the Cloud Pub/Sub topic created for this Channel Services account.

params.name: account
params.description: Required. Resource name of the account.
